description: Open a project, render the viewport and export the textures.

identity.goal: Complete the export textures use case of texturecraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the texturecraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `texturecraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced texturecraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `texturecraft_project_open`, `texturecraft_viewport_render`, `texturecraft_textures_export`, `texturecraft_mesh_export`. Steps: (1) Open the project. (2) Render the viewport to verify. (3) Export the textures. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace texturecraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
